interface.shortDescription: Short drama creation workflow on Jimeng Canvas via jimeng-novel CLI
interface.longDescription: Turn a story idea or existing script into multi-episode short dramas on Jimeng Canvas using the jimeng-novel CLI. Covers story setting, episode outlines, scriptwriting, character/scene sheets, storyboard prompting, image/video/audio generation, credit estimation, canvas syncing, and local FFmpeg composition.
